root_cause.text: In the md/raid5 subsystem, `retry_aligned_read()` triggers a race condition by releasing an overlapped stripe via `raid5_release_stripe()`, which causes the stripe to be re-queued on `handle_list` by `raid5d` before `handle_stripe()` processes it, preventing overlap resolution.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces the call to `raid5_release_stripe(sh)` with `__release_stripe(conf, sh, &conf->temp_inactive_list[hash])` to prevent the stripe from entering the `released_stripes` llist and subsequently `handle_list`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes potential race condition in stripe release by adding proper spinlock protection and hash-based inactive list management
intent_record.what: Replaced single-line call to raid5_release_stripe(sh) with a locked sequence that acquires device_lock, reads hash_lock_index, calls __release_stripe with temp_inactive_list[hash], then releases the lock
intent_record.how: Adds spin_lock_irq/spin_unlock_irq protection around stripe release operation, ensuring thread-safe modification of the temp_inactive_list by using hash-based bucket selection instead of generic release path
